name: end card: icon, wordmark and tagline settle among drifting photo cards
looks: A ring of soft light pulses gently around a small rounded app icon. The icon and a matching wordmark settle together, a short tagline fades in under them, and small photo cards drift slowly at the frame's edges, out of focus, for texture rather than content.
build: The icon and wordmark arrive together as one group, y:8-12px->0, opacity 0->1, power2.out; the ring is a blurred circle pulsing slowly on the clock. The tagline fades in 150-200ms after the lockup settles. Two to four drifting card sprites sit at different depths and speeds behind the lockup for parallax, never sharp enough to read.
sound: A soft low swell fading out under the hold, no new hits once the lockup settles.
prompt: Close on the brand's mark and name settling together on a calm, softly lit field, a one-line promise fading in under them. Let a few out-of-focus samples of the work drift slowly at the edges for atmosphere, and hold the finished lockup without further motion.
